name: The Veil Wardens
description: A secret order of psychic architects who maintain the ancient rituals protecting Anchorholds, now fracturing over how to respond to the crisis.
goals: Repair critical breaches in the Veil using established rituals at any cost
Purge the order of reformers who advocate for controlled fusion with the dream realm
Capture and study the unlikely guardian to understand its connection to the degradation
resources: Monopoly on Veil-reinforcing rituals, control of major Anchorhold governance, psychic archives, and disciplined enforcer corps.
